definitions.explanation: Having an irritating sensation that makes one want to scratch.

examples.japanese: かゆいところに{手|て}が{届|とど}く。
examples.english: To be attentive to every need. (Idiom)

notes:
かゆい is an i-adjective meaning itchy.

WRITING:
Usually written in hiragana. Kanji {痒|かゆ}い is less common.

FORMS:
- Adverbial: かゆく
- Noun form: かゆみ (itchiness)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {背中|せなか}がかゆい: my back is itchy
- かゆくなる: to become itchy
- かゆみ{止|ど}め: anti-itch medicine

IDIOM:
{痒|かゆ}い{所|ところ}に{手|て}が{届|とど}く: literally "reaches the itchy spot" - describes meticulous, attentive service that anticipates every need.

RELATED:
- {掻|か}く: to scratch
